post.title: Why the average wedding costs $34,200
post.ig:
The average 2025 wedding cost $34,200 (The Knot).

That's $292 per guest across an average of 117 guests.
Venue averaged $12,900; catering $80 a person ($9,360 for 117); photographer $3,000. Venue plus food: about 65% of the bill.
Average cost: $19,000 in 2020, $35,000 in 2023, $34,200 in 2025.

Sources: The Knot 2026 Real Weddings Study (10,474 couples married in 2025); earlier Knot studies.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
